stories.headline: George Simion launches attacks on President Nicușor Dan and faces criticism over US visit
stories.summary: AUR leader George Simion called for President Nicușor Dan to not complete his mandate, calling him 'a danger to Romania.' Simion also faced international mockery for participating in a Greenland-shaped cake ceremony in Washington alongside Republican congressmen, as part of his controversial US visit.

stories.headline: PNL member Adriana Georgescu arrested by DNA in high-profile bribery case
stories.summary: Lawyer and PNL Sector 1 member Adriana Georgescu was arrested by DNA for allegedly receiving 60,000 euros in bribes, promising to influence justice cases. She was arrested alongside a fake SIE general. The case has sparked internal PNL disputes about her role and position in the party.

stories.headline: United States deploys Abrams tanks and additional troops to Romania
stories.summary: The US announced deployment of American soldiers equipped with M1A2 Abrams tanks to Romania on a rotational basis. Romanian defense officials characterized this as improving the 'quality and lethality' of US forces in Romania while maintaining the same overall troop numbers. The deployment is part of strengthened NATO presence on the eastern flank.

stories.headline: BNR maintains key interest rates and announces banknote signature changes
stories.summary: Romania's central bank kept interest rates unchanged in January to support economic growth while managing inflation. BNR also announced the first change to banknote signatures in 25 years, with new casier central Mugur Tolici's signature appearing on money from February 1. Economic data shows increased money supply but weak credit growth.

stories.headline: NATO chief Mark Rutte says Europe cannot defend itself without US, sparks debate
stories.summary: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte told the European Parliament that Europe is incapable of defending itself without US support, dismissing the idea of European strategic autonomy as 'dreaming.' Romanian officials supported Rutte's position, while the comments sparked broader debate about European defense independence and NATO's future.

stories.headline: Romania announces €16.6 billion defense modernization plan under EU SAFE program
stories.summary: Romania detailed plans for major defense investments under the EU's Security Action for Europe program, including tank procurement, helicopter purchases, and infrastructure projects. The country is also accelerating main battle tank acquisition decisions and building the A7 motorway to Moldova with partial military use.

stories.headline: EU and India sign historic trade agreement with implications for Romanian business
stories.summary: The European Union and India concluded a major free trade agreement after 20 years of negotiations, creating one of the world's largest trade zones. Romanian analysts highlighted opportunities for strategic investments from India in renewable energy, aerospace, chemicals and IT sectors, similar to how other EU countries have attracted investments from major powers.
